source_group: SHA-256 of the complete source video

event.window: Nearest 6-second PTS window; point annotations are weak labels, not verified event intervals
event.confirmed_interval: events: start_sec, end_sec, review_status=confirmed; only complete reviewed intervals enable same-video negative windows

notes: Violation types are hypotheses and are not trained as separate classes because the case data has no class-level ground truth.
Duplicate files always remain in one split.
Х-4 and Х-47 are one positive source with two retained candidate events: 57 and 68 seconds.
Х-5 and Х-48 are one negative source.
